note: Scene plates for Sub character (윤하). gen_plates.py sends each prompt to Codex CLI image generation, prep_plates.py resizes raw/<id>.png into <id>.webp for cine.html. Original characters only.
style: Cinematic anime feature-film background painting, hand-painted look with soft brush texture, original artwork. Mood: quiet, lonely, theatrical, like a scene from a film about being a side character. Palette: desaturated cool blue-grey shadows (#56637F, #AAB4C8) against one warm golden spotlight (#FFB940), with deep muted magenta-red accents in stage curtains. Volumetric light beams with floating dust, atmospheric haze, gentle bloom, subtle film grain. Vertical composition for a phone screen; keep the upper-middle of the frame calm and fairly dark and uncluttered (lyrics are placed there). Characters are small to medium in the frame, never close-up faces; faces are simple and partly in shadow. The two recurring original characters (not from any existing work): 'YOU' = a teenage boy with short messy dark hair wearing a plain light-grey hoodie; 'ME' = a teenage girl with long straight dark hair, a dark navy school blazer and a muted grey-blue scarf. Bodies and limbs must be anatomically correct and physically plausible. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs with writing, logos or watermark.

plates.prompt: A theater stage seen from the audience. Dark muted magenta-red curtain valance across the very top. One strong warm golden spotlight falls from above onto the center of the stage floor in the lower half, where YOU stand, facing us, small in the frame (about one fifth of the image height), glowing at the rim. At the far left edge of the stage, outside the light, ME stands in cool blue-grey shadow, half hidden, looking toward YOU. In the foreground at the very bottom, a row of dark audience silhouettes (backs of heads and shoulders). Haze and dust in the beam.

An empty dark theater stage with black drapes. A single narrow golden spotlight from high above onto the center of the stage floor in the lower part of the frame, where YOU stand alone facing us, small in the frame, rim-lit gold. Everything else is deep blue-black darkness with faint haze. Nobody else is visible.

A long empty school corridor in one-point perspective, cool blue-grey dusk light through windows along the left wall, polished floor reflecting light. At the far end of the corridor, very small, YOU walk away from us into a warm golden glow of light, seen from behind. In the foreground lower-left, ME stand seen from behind (back of head, long dark hair, grey-blue scarf, blazer shoulders), a large dark silhouette cut by the bottom-left edge of the frame, watching YOU.

Behind the scenes of a film shoot: a small studio set with a painted backdrop wall, the edges of the set visible. YOU stand in the center in a warm golden key light, the star of the scene. Around the edges, several background extras stand in dim cool light, plain and anonymous; among them on the left side is ME. Film lights on tall stands at the left and right edges aimed at YOU, a boom microphone pole reaching in from the top-left, and a large dark film camera on a tripod in the lower-right foreground, pointed at YOU.

A dim backstage dressing room at night. A large vanity mirror framed by round warm light bulbs (a few bulbs are dead) in the upper-center. In the lower foreground ME sit on a stool seen from behind, head slightly lowered, long dark hair and grey-blue scarf; in the mirror we see ME's reflection from the front, face mostly in shadow. Cool blue-grey tones everywhere except the warm bulbs. A cluttered table with makeup brushes, no text anywhere.

Backstage between two heavy dark magenta-red velvet curtains that fill the left and right thirds of the frame. In the narrow gap in the middle, a dim warm pool of light on the floor, where YOU sit alone on a wooden crate, knees drawn up, head down, arms around the knees, looking tired and hurt. At the right curtain edge, ME peek out from behind the curtain in shadow, only half visible, watching quietly.

Top-down view of an old dark wooden desk at night under a warm desk lamp pool of light: a few blank sheets of paper scattered at the edges, a pencil, a pink eraser with eraser crumbs, an old film reel, a coffee cup ring stain. The lower-middle of the desk is left clear and empty. The papers are completely blank (no writing at all).

A split composition divided exactly down the vertical middle by the hard edge of a stage flat. Left half: warm golden spotlight, YOU stand in the light in the lower-left quarter, glowing, facing slightly right. Right half: cold dim blue-grey, ME stand alone in the lower-right quarter in shadow, facing slightly left. The two halves feel like two different worlds.

A completely empty, dark theater stage after the show: bare black floor in the lower third with a faint sheen, black drapes, a row of unlit stage light fixtures hanging from a rig at the very top. Almost pitch dark, only a very faint cool haze. No people at all.

A dark empty theater stage after the show, black drapes, unlit stage lights hanging from a rig at the top. Two separate spotlights on the stage floor in the lower third: on the left a thin cold white-blue spotlight where ME stand alone facing right toward YOU, arms at her sides; on the right a warm golden spotlight where YOU stand with his back turned to ME, facing away toward the right. A wide gap of darkness between them. Both small in the frame (about one fifth of the image height), full bodies visible, feet on the floor.

The same dark empty theater stage. One wide warm golden spotlight now covers both of them at the center of the stage floor in the lower third: ME (left) and YOU (right) stand facing each other and hold hands between them, a small soft glow where their hands meet. ME's grey-blue scarf is lit warm gold by the light. Floating golden dust in the beam. Both small in the frame (about one fifth of the image height), full bodies visible, arms and hands anatomically correct.
